_about: How addresses work (engine/addresses.py; inputs from address_prep.py): Ontario Street (Carrall Street downtown) splits the city into East and West. Streets that cross it take W or E before the name (W Broadway, E Hastings St) and their numbers rise 100 a block going away from it. North-south streets count up going south from the inlet, about 100 an avenue: the hundreds are the avenue plus 15 south of False Creek (4000 Main St is at 25th Avenue).
